order.code: const es=self.nearbyEnemies().filter(e=>e.type!=="wall"&&e.type!=="door");const as=self.nearbyAllies();let urgent=es.some(e=>self.distanceTo(e)<=(e.type==="knight"?4:e.type==="ranger"?6:e.type==="turret"?6:e.type==="castle"?5:2));if(!urgent){self.hold();}else{let best=null,score=-1e9;for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++)for(let dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++){let x=self.x+dx,y=self.y+dy;if(x<0||y<0||x>31||y>31||as.some(a=>a.x===x&&a.y===y)||es.some(e=>e.x===x&&e.y===y))continue;let s=0;for(const e of es){let d=Math.max(Math.abs(x-e.x),Math.abs(y-e.y));let r=e.type==="turret"?5:e.type==="ranger"||e.type==="castle"?4:1;let w=e.type==="castle"||e.type==="worker"||e.type==="king"?0.3:1;s+=w*Math.min(d,8)*3;if(d<=r+1)s-=w*(r+2-d)*20;}s+=Math.min(x,y,31-x,31-y)*0.5;if(s>score){score=s;best={x,y};}}if(best&&(best.x!==self.x||best.y!==self.y))self.moveTo(best.x,best.y);else self.hold();}

const es=self.nearbyEnemies();const as=self.nearbyAllies();const ps=self.projectiles().filter(p=>p.owner==="p2");let danger=false;for(const p of ps){let dx=self.x-p.x,dy=self.y-p.y,v=p.vx*p.vx+p.vy*p.vy,t=(dx*p.vx+dy*p.vy)/v;if(t>=0&&t<0.5&&Math.hypot(dx-p.vx*t,dy-p.vy*t)<0.65)danger=true;}const melee=es.filter(e=>e.type==="knight"&&self.distanceTo(e)<=2);if(danger||melee.length){let best=null,bs=-1e9;for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++)for(let dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++){if(!dx&&!dy)continue;let x=self.x+dx,y=self.y+dy;if(x<0||y<0||x>31||y>31||as.some(a=>a.x===x&&a.y===y)||es.some(e=>e.x===x&&e.y===y))continue;let s=-Math.max(Math.abs(x-20),Math.abs(y-20))*0.05;for(const e of es){let d=Math.max(Math.abs(x-e.x),Math.abs(y-e.y));if(e.type==="knight"&&d<=2)s-=70*(3-d);if(e.type==="turret"&&d<=5)s-=25;}for(const p of ps){let rx=x-p.x,ry=y-p.y,v=p.vx*p.vx+p.vy*p.vy,t=(rx*p.vx+ry*p.vy)/v;if(t>=0&&t<0.65&&Math.hypot(rx-p.vx*t,ry-p.vy*t)<0.65)s-=100;}if(s>bs){bs=s;best={x,y};}}if(best){self.moveTo(best.x,best.y);return;}}let targets=es.filter(e=>self.distanceTo(e)<=self.range);targets.sort((a,b)=>{const w=e=>(e.type==="ranger"?0:e.type==="knight"?10:e.type==="worker"?20:e.type==="turret"?30:e.type==="king"?40:60)+e.hp/100;return w(a)-w(b);});if(targets.length){self.attack(targets[0]);return;}let target=es.filter(e=>e.type!=="wall"&&e.type!=="door").sort((a,b)=>self.distanceTo(a)-self.distanceTo(b))[0];if(target){self.moveTo(target.x,target.y);}else{self.moveTo(18+(parseInt(self.id.slice(1))%3),18+(parseInt(self.id.slice(1))%2));}
